situations.title: 접지 패드 부착
situations.tagline: Place the grounding pad on clean, dry skin over good muscle mass.
situations.brief: 접지판을 근육이 많은 깨끗한 부위에 부착하세요.
keyPhrases: Pick a spot with good muscle, like the thigh.
Skin needs to be clean and dry first.
Keep it close to the surgical site but not over bone.

situations.title: 소작기 출력 설정
situations.tagline: Let's confirm the cut and coag settings with the surgeon before we start.
situations.brief: 집도의와 함께 소작기 출력 설정을 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: What settings do you want for cut and coag?
I'll set it and read it back to you.
Lowest effective setting keeps the patient safer.

situations.title: 패드 피부 밀착 확인
situations.tagline: Run your hand around the pad edge to make sure it's fully adhered.
situations.brief: 접지 패드가 피부에 완전히 밀착되었는지 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Check that all edges are flat with no lifting.
No gaps, or you risk a burn.
The whole pad should contact the skin evenly.

situations.title: 소작기 작동 점검
situations.tagline: Let's test the unit and check the alarms before the incision.
situations.brief: 절개 전 소작기 작동과 알람을 점검하세요.
keyPhrases: Power it on and confirm the tone works.
Check the pad contact alarm is active.
Everything reads normal, we're good to go.

situations.title: 활성 전극 보관
situations.tagline: When it's not in use, park the active electrode in its holster.
situations.brief: 사용하지 않는 활성 전극을 holster에 안전하게 보관하세요.
keyPhrases: Always holster the pencil when it's idle.
Never leave it loose on the drapes.
That keeps an accidental activation off the patient.

situations.title: 연기 배출 확인
situations.tagline: Turn on the smoke evacuator so we're not breathing the plume.
situations.brief: 소작 연기를 배출하도록 smoke evacuation을 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Switch on the smoke evacuator before we cauterize.
Keep the nozzle close to the source.
Surgical smoke is a real inhalation hazard.

situations.title: 접지 패드 부위 선택
situations.tagline: Let's pick a well-muscled area and avoid bony or scarred skin.
situations.brief: 근육 위 부위를 골라 접지 패드를 부착하세요.
keyPhrases: Muscle conducts better and spreads the current.
Avoid bone, scar tissue, and hairy skin.
Keep it as close to the site as practical.

situations.title: 금속 이식물 우회
situations.tagline: She has a hip implant, so keep the current path away from that metal.
situations.brief: 금속 이식물을 피해 접지 패드 위치를 선정하세요.
keyPhrases: Place the pad so current avoids the implant.
Metal can concentrate the current and burn tissue.
Keep the return path clear of the prosthesis.
goals: 전류 경로가 금속 이식물을 지나지 않게 배치한다

situations.title: 소작 연기 흡입 저감
situations.tagline: Let's tighten up smoke capture, the plume is drifting toward the team.
situations.brief: 소작 연기 흡입을 줄이도록 배출을 조정하세요.
keyPhrases: The evacuator nozzle needs to be right at the tip.
Bump up the suction so we capture the plume.
Nobody should be inhaling this smoke.

situations.title: 소아 접지 패드 크기
situations.tagline: This is a pediatric case, so we need the correctly sized child pad.
situations.brief: 소아 환자에게 맞는 접지 패드 크기를 선택하세요.
keyPhrases: An adult pad on a child concentrates the current.
Match the pad to the patient's weight range.
Confirm full skin contact on smaller anatomy.
goals: 환자 체중에 맞는 소아 패드를 선택한다

situations.title: 습기·소독액 화상 예방
situations.tagline: Let's make sure no prep solution pooled under the pad or the drapes.
situations.brief: 소독액 고임과 습기로 인한 화상을 예방하세요.
keyPhrases: Wet skin under the pad can cause a burn.
Wick away any pooled prep before we drape.
Let the alcohol prep dry fully first.
goals: 패드 아래와 드레이프의 소독액 고임을 제거한다

situations.title: 단극·양극 선택
situations.tagline: For this delicate tissue, let's set up bipolar instead of monopolar.
situations.brief: 조직과 상황에 맞게 mono·bipolar를 선택하세요.
keyPhrases: Bipolar keeps the current between the tips.
Monopolar needs a return pad, bipolar doesn't.
Near a pacemaker, bipolar is safer.

situations.title: 오류 알람 대응
situations.tagline: The unit's throwing a pad contact alarm, let's find the fault.
situations.brief: 소작기 오류 알람을 확인하고 원인을 찾으세요.
keyPhrases: That alarm means the pad contact is poor.
Check for a lifted edge or a loose cable.
Don't reactivate until we clear the fault.
goals: 원인을 찾아 해결한 뒤 사용을 재개한다

situations.title: 부착면 피부 준비
situations.tagline: Let's clip the hair and wipe the site so the pad seats well.
situations.brief: 체모 제거와 피부 준비로 접지면을 마련하세요.
keyPhrases: Clip, don't shave, to avoid nicks.
Wipe off lotion or moisture first.
Good prep means good contact and no burns.

situations.title: 이동 후 접촉 재확인
situations.tagline: We repositioned him, so let's re-check the pad hasn't shifted or lifted.
situations.brief: 환자 이동 후 접지 패드 접촉을 재확인하세요.
keyPhrases: After repositioning, always recheck the pad.
Feel for any edge that lifted during the move.
If it shifted, we replace it, not press it back.
goals: 체위 변경 후 패드 접촉을 다시 확인한다
들뜬 경우 눌러 붙이지 않고 교체한다

situations.title: 접지 부위 화상 발견
situations.tagline: There's a burn under the grounding pad, stop and let's get this documented.
situations.brief: 접지 부위 화상을 발견하면 즉시 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: I see a burn where the pad was seated.
Stop cautery and notify the surgeon and anesthesia.
We need photos, wound care, and an incident report.

situations.title: 심박동기 소작 간섭
situations.tagline: He has a pacemaker, so monopolar could interfere, let's alert anesthesia now.
situations.brief: pacemaker 환자에서 소작 간섭 위기에 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: Monopolar EMI can disrupt his pacemaker.
Switch to bipolar or use short bursts.
Anesthesia, do we need the magnet ready?

situations.title: 소작기 오작동 화재 위험
situations.tagline: I smell smoke and there's oxygen pooling, kill the ESU before this ignites.
situations.brief: 소작기 오작동과 발화 위험을 즉시 차단하세요.
keyPhrases: Deactivate the ESU, we have an ignition risk.
Turn down the oxygen and remove the fuel source.
Get the fire extinguisher and saline ready.

situations.title: 접지 실패 응급 대응
situations.tagline: The return pad failed mid-case, let's secure an alternate path before we cauterize again.
situations.brief: 접지 실패 시 대체 접지를 확보하도록 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: The return electrode isn't reading, hold cautery.
Let's place a new pad on fresh muscle.
Verify contact before we reactivate.

situations.title: ICD 방전 위험
situations.tagline: She has an ICD, so let's disable therapy before we use cautery to avoid a shock.
situations.brief: 제세동기 방전 위험에 대비해 소작 전에 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: Cautery could trigger an inappropriate ICD shock.
We should suspend the ICD with a magnet or programming.
Keep external defib pads on and ready.
goals: 소작으로 인한 ICD 오작동 위험을 인지한다
ICD 정지와 외부 제세동 대비를 조율한다

situations.title: 전기 손상 광범위 발견
situations.tagline: There's more tissue damage than expected, let's assess the full extent of this electrical injury.
situations.brief: 광범위한 전기 손상을 발견하고 평가하세요.
keyPhrases: This burn extends beyond the pad site.
Let's map the full area of injury.
Notify the surgeon, we may need a consult.
